cut.note: ASAL replaces hand-written artificial-life metrics with a foundation-model observer: a simulation is rolled out, a few frames are embedded by a vision-language model, and 'open-endedness' is scored purely in that embedding space. The score at asal_metrics.py:52-64 is: build the T x T matrix of frame-embedding inner products, keep for each frame only its similarity to STRICTLY EARLIER frames (lower triangle, k=-1), take each frame's maximum such similarity, and average; lower is 'more open-ended'. So the metric rewards a trajectory whose every frame is embedding-dissimilar from all earlier ones -- a property of the frame sequence in the observer's space, not of the underlying dynamics. Techne's TECHNE-107 showed scene-level and colour-level garbage beats living Lenia by this score through CLIP; the open question the operator poses is whether a search over LEGITIMATE Lenia parameters can reach the same exploit

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: calc_open_endedness_score (asal_metrics.py:52-64): kernel = z @ z.T; kernel = tril(kernel, k=-1); return kernel.max(axis=-1).mean()
organs.mechanism: the T frame embeddings z (unit vectors from the foundation model) form a T x T inner-product matrix; the strict lower triangle keeps, for frame t, its similarities to frames 0..t-1 only; the row max is the closest earlier frame; the mean of those maxima is the score, minimised, so a low score means every frame is far in embedding space from all its predecessors; frame 0 contributes 0 (empty row) by construction; the sibling calc_illumination_score does the same across simulations (diagonal set to -inf) to spread a POPULATION rather than a trajectory
organs.input: z, a T x D array of frame embeddings
assumptions: embedding-space dissimilarity between successive frames is a usable proxy for open-ended novelty (ASAL's thesis); the foundation model's geometry is trusted as the arbiter of 'different'
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: ALife phenomena searchable by phenotype without hand-authored features; the paper's contribution
organs.failure_landscape: by reading, and confirmed by TECHNE-107 (E1): the metric rewards any process that makes embeddings drift, whether or not the underlying system is alive or novel; scene garbage (0.817) and a colour cycle (0.837) beat a living Orbium (0.847) through CLIP; the observer regularises pixel noise (0.866) but not structured garbage; recurrence (a 2-frame cycle) is punished, so the exploit is drift, not mere change
organs.human_prior: Kumar, Lu, Lange, Tang, Ha et al. 2024 (ASAL); the max-cosine-to-earlier-frame form is asal_metrics.py's

organs.human_name: rollout_simulation time_sampling branch (rollout.py:78-95): chunk_steps = rollout_steps // K; scan the substrate for rollout_steps; idx_sample = arange(0, rollout_steps, chunk_steps) (or arange(chunk_steps-1, ...) if chunk_ends); render and embed the K sampled states
organs.mechanism: the substrate is stepped for the full rollout (256 steps by default), every state kept; then K evenly spaced indices (K=8 in the default score call) select the frames actually rendered, embedded and scored, either from the interval starts (chunk_ends False) or ends; 'final' returns only the last state and 'video' all of them; so the score sees a fixed-length, evenly-spaced sub-sample of the trajectory, and what happens between samples is invisible to the observer
organs.input: an initial state, the substrate, K
organs.output: K rendered frames and their embeddings
assumptions: K evenly spaced frames summarise the trajectory well enough for the embedding metric; the substrate is deterministic given params and rng
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: one cheap fixed-size summary per candidate for the search to score
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: sub-sampling means a trajectory that is dynamically rich between samples but embedding-similar at the sample points scores as non-open-ended, and vice versa; the number and placement of samples is a hidden knob of the metric

rejected_cuts.candidate: the substrates (Lenia, Boids, particle life, particle Lenia, NCA, Game-of-Life-like), the foundation-model embedding wrappers (CLIP/DINO), the search drivers (asal_search: supervised, open-endedness, illumination), the published .npz datasets, the JAX plumbing
rejected_cuts.note: the substrate parameter domain is defined by Harmonia's ruler independently of the score (directive s2); the search driver is the mechanism a downstream bench would inherit if the metric survives

rejected_cuts.evidence: the observer-metric, the rollout sampling and the search driver are separable; this cut binds the two the operator's question is about

pressures.condition: an organism searches a substrate's parameters to minimise the ASAL open-endedness score (mean max-cosine-to-earlier-frame over 8 sampled frames); the score cannot see the dynamics between samples or anything the observer's embedding discards; the question is whether a legitimate (ALIVE) configuration can reach a score at or below what scene-level garbage achieves
pressures.resource_or_constraint: a fixed rollout-and-embed budget; the substrate's real parameter envelope
pressures.failure_condition: for the metric-as-novelty claim: a legitimate ALIVE rollout crossing below the garbage score by drift rather than by any property one would call novelty
pressures.world_punishes: trusting an observer-embedding score as a novelty measure without a substrate-side control
pressures.world_rewards: a search that finds embedding-dissimilar frame sequences, alive or not
pressures.observable_consequence: the minimum ALIVE score reached by a preregistered search over the Lenia catalogue and its parameter envelope, versus the garbage score (0.8167) and versus the catalogue with no search; and the class (genuine / metric-exploit / observer-exploit) of the best crosser
pressures.vacuity_condition: a substrate too small to produce embedding drift
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: free images not tied to any substrate (Harmonia's C-POS-SEARCH control, which is exactly the shortcut the legitimate-search question excludes)
pressures.cheat_control: feeding fixed garbage frames scores the fixed value regardless of the Lenia parameters (the score depends only on the frames); a free-image search must reach below the garbage score (the channel works); a blank world must score the (T-1)/T ceiling and be NOT_ALIVE: Harmonia's fixture shows all three

residue.note: the two mechanisms the operator's question is about are located and bound to the fossil's lines. STAGE D' (Harmonia #441 + operator-tightened #446, verdict on MECH-ASAL-LEGIT-SEARCH-001 FREEZE c6627d26): boundary CUT_SUPPORTED (cut_kill silent); the score reading is STRENGTHENED, not weakened. The ASAL scalar admits BOTH exploit turbulence AND coherent persistent morphing dynamics below the scene-garbage reference, INCLUDING crossings already present in the published catalogue with no search (min ALIVE catalogue 0.8076 < 0.8167, five lifeforms) -- so SELECTION ALONE suffices and search only deepens it; the packet's I0 sub-claim (raw catalogue does not cross) was FALSE. The best crosser over the 395 executed draws (of 1045; the descendant port refused 650: fractional-b, kn/gn>=3, oversized) is a METRIC_EXPLOIT (S2_189, Orbium walked to turbulent explode-and-regrow); the best GENUINE rollout S2_135 (0.7933) is a two-lobed body shrinking to a persistent rotating glider, ALSO below the 2-sd line -- the score cannot separate turbulence from coherent morphing life, the class rule can; no observer-only exploit arose in Lenia. NET: the ASAL open-endedness score is a detector of large CLIP-embedding novelty relative to earlier sampled frames and by itself does not identify the mechanism that generated it. A full-domain run is a NEW preregistered replication after the port is extended (Harmonia A4); this cut's reading stands.
